石溪村，老李家！

村子外面的动静太大，不少人家都被吵醒了，纷纷打开门朝着外面张望，老李家自然也都被吵醒了，李老屯外面套着一件破旧褂子走出来时，李大奎和李二奎，以及李青书已经站在院子里。

“发生什么事情了，外面吵吵闹闹的？”李老屯睡眼惺忪，开口问道。

“爹，好像是三奎和李财他们上山去了！”李三奎开口道。

“这大晚上的，上山干什么？”李老屯皱了皱眉头道。

“这，谁知道啊！”

“去了二十多口子呢，我看还抬着担架上去的。”

李三奎道。

“啥？”

“去了二三十口子？”

“还抬着担架过去的？”

“这大晚上的，去这么多人，还抬着担架？”

“不会是李青山那小崽子在山上出事情，死了吧？”

李老屯料想道。

在李老屯的心里，早就恨死李青山了，巴不得李青山早点死，所以在听到自家儿子的话后，第一时间便感觉是李青山死在山上了。

“三叔，你看到是谁回来报信的吗？”李青书也是脸上一喜，旋即开口问道。

“大壮回来的！”

“我看到人群里有大壮，急匆匆走在最前面，一边走还一边催促着。”

李三奎道。

“那李财呢，李财哭了没有？”李青书急忙道。

“没啊，没哭！”李三奎摇了摇头。

“三叔呢？三叔哭了没有？”李青书再次问道。

“没看见老三，估计在人群里吧，匆匆走了过去，我也就是看了一眼，声音很杂，好像……好像是有哭声吧？”

在李青书这李老屯这种心理暗示下，李二奎也拿不定主意，但努力回忆下，自认为应该是有哭声的。

“哎呀！”

“爷，这大晚上一群老李家的人上山，还抬着担架，三叔还哭了，肯定是李青山死在山上了啊！”

Shixi Village, Lao Li’s house!

There was so much noise outside the village that many people were woken up and opened their doors to look outside. Naturally, Old Li's family was also woken up. When Li Laotun walked out wearing a shabby coat, Li Dakui, Li Erkui, and Li Qingshu were already standing in the yard.

"What happened? Is there so much noise outside?" Li Laotun asked sleepily.

"Dad, it seems Sankui and Li Cai have gone up the mountain!" Li Sankui said.

"Why are you going up the mountain this late at night?" Li Laotun frowned and asked.

"Who knows!"

"More than 20 people have gone there. I think they even carried a stretcher up there."

Li Sankui said.

"What?"

"Have you been there for twenty or thirty years?"

"You even carried a stretcher over there?"

"It's so late at night, so many people are going there, and they're carrying a stretcher?"

"It's not like that kid Li Qingshan died in something happened on the mountain, right?"

Li Laotun thought.

In Li Laotun's heart, he had long hated Li Qingshan and wished that Li Qingshan would die soon. Therefore, after hearing his son's words, he immediately felt that Li Qingshan had died on the mountain.

"Third uncle, did you see who came back to report the news?" Li Qingshu also had a happy face and asked immediately.

"Dazhuang is back!"

"I saw a big guy in the crowd, hurriedly walking at the front, urging him as he walked."

Li Sankui said.

"What about Li Cai? Did Li Cai cry?" Li Qingshu asked hurriedly.

"No, I'm not crying!" Li Sankui shook his head.

"Where is Third Uncle? Has Third Uncle cried?" Li Qingshu asked again.

"I didn't see the third child. He must be in the crowd. He walked over in a hurry. I just took a look. There was a lot of noise. It seemed... there seemed to be crying, right?"

Under the psychological suggestion of Li Qingshu and Li Laotun, Li Erkui couldn't make up his mind, but after trying his best to recall, he thought there should be crying.

"Ouch!"

"Master, a group of people from the old Li family went up the mountain this night, carrying a stretcher, and the third uncle was crying. Li Qingshan must have died on the mountain!"
